EGY.note: AI development is named as a pillar of a sovereignty strategy; no rule or authority on AI harms is stated.
No government use of an AI system is stated.
No AI tool in a sector's public system is stated.
AI development is named as a strategy pillar without a model, dataset or facility, builder, funder or site.
Data protection is named as a strategy pillar; no law is described.

facts.fact: Communications and IT Minister Raafat Hindy said Egypt's digital sovereignty strategy rests on five pillars: sovereign digital infrastructure, cybersecurity, AI, data protection and technology talent.
